title: Zainab Nahi hai tanha
body:
Haye Zainab....(4)
<<MINI>>
Zainab nahi hain tanha Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Qurbaan jab hua tha...(2)
Ahmed ka sab gharana....
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...
<<DIVIDER>>
(1) Purkhari rahguzar thi, Dushwaar marhalein the Phir bhi buland ya Rab, Zainab ke hauslein the
Ban kar Hussain Abid....(2)
Ka hausla badhaya
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya...
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya..
<<DIVIDER>>
(2) Bhulegi kaise Zainab, Karbobala ka manzar
Barpa hua tha kaisa, Aale Nabi pe mehshar
Khaimon me aag jis dam....(2)
Zaalim ne tha lagaya...
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya...
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya..
<<DIVIDER>>
(3) Hairaan hoke ya Rab, sab Ambiya ne dekha
Darbaar e ashkiyaan me, Bint e Ali ka lehja
Main hoon Ali ki beti....(2)
Zainab ne yu bataya....
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya...
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...
<<DIVIDER>>
(4) Rassiyan bandhi hui hain, Zainab ke baazuon par Phir bhi kiya na shikwa, Zainab ne aafaton par
Baad e Hussain Nana....(2)
Ka Deen hain bachaya...
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya...
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...
<<DIVIDER>>
(5) Maqtal me chhod ayi, Sibt e Nabi ka lasha
Beton ko kaise apne, Deen e Khuda pe waara
Chashm e Falak ne dekha....(2)
Andaaz e Saaberana...
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya....
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya....
<<DIVIDER>>
(6) Waada har ek apna, Zainab nibha rahi hain
Sabr o Raza ka paikar, bankar dikha rahi hain
Ummat ne zulm dhaya ...(2)
Jis waqt inteha ka....
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...
<<DIVIDER>>
(7) Zainab ke ronewalon, Paigham e Karbala hain
Shohada ke khoon se afzal, Maa behnon ki rida hain
Hain pairwaan e Zainab...(2)
Bankar tumhein dikhana....
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya...
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...
<<DIVIDER>>
(8) Mere Khudaya ho phir, Shahid ka khwaab pura
Barpa ho Sheh ki majlis, Ya Rab sar e Baqaiya
Hasrat hain us zameen par....(2)
Zainab ka gham sunana...
<<MINI>>
Ya Rab tera tha saya....
Zainab nahi hain tanha, Karbal me aye Khudaya, Ya Rab tera tha saya...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Zainab....(5)
